topics.title: BI 764198 (TRPC6i) Ph III in pFSGS (1434-0017) — China Leading PI Selection (TA-CEC @ 2025-05-12)

background.text: Evidence Team proposed Prof. Xueqing Yu (余学清) as China Leading PI based on: international influence (President of APSN, Dean of Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital), extensive MRCT experience (China Leading PI in over 20 trials), China Leading PI of TRPC6i Ph II (1434-0004) contributing 4/8 China patients, site has MSA with Boehringer and demonstrated fast start-up (4.8 months CTA submission to SIV).
background.quote:
Evidence Team proposed to select Prof. Xueqing Yu (余学清) as the China Leading PI of the Ph III trial based on the following considerations:

Great domestic and international influence in the field with important positions in various associations (e.g. President of APSN) and as the Dean of Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital
Extensive clinical and research experience in the field,China Leading PI in over 20 clinical trials including many MRCTs.

background.text: HPSC endorsed PoCP release and all planned development activities for pFSGS, podocytopathies and DMD. China EoPh II submission on 09 Apr with CDE feedback expected early Jul. China country feasibility completed. BTD application under planning, likely after EoPh II FDA feedback in early Jun.
background.quote:
HPSC endorsed PoCP release and all planned development activities for pFSGS, podocytopathies and DMD indications.

China leading PI proposal aligned between TA Medicine and CD&O
China country feasibility completed and feedback provided to global team

for_endorsement.text: Proposal to select Prof. Xueqing Yu (余学清) as China Leading PI for BI 764198 Ph III trial in pFSGS (1434-0017) submitted to TA-CEC.
for_endorsement.quote: Evidence Team proposed to select Prof. Xueqing Yu (余学清) as the China Leading PI of the Ph III trial

decision.text: TA-CEC agreed with the proposal to select Prof. Xueqing Yu as China Leading PI. TA-CEC also suggested the team explore feasibility of including Prof. Yu in the Steering Committee (SC) of the trial.
decision.quote:
CEC agreed with the proposal

Suggested team to explore the feasibility of including Prof. Yu in the Steering Committee (SC) of the trial.
